symptom.observed: The 5520 Responses request reached minimax_openai with two concatenated JSON objects in function_call.arguments; MiniMax rejected the provider request with HTTP 400 code 2013.
symptom.expected: The adjacent Responses-to-OpenAI-Chat codec must preserve the exact function.arguments string value, preserve paired tool output, send once to the selected OpenAI Chat target, and avoid provider failure or reselect.

hypotheses.cause: The Responses-to-OpenAI-Chat path incorrectly treated function.arguments parseability as a ProviderReqCompat requirement even though OpenAI Chat defines function.arguments as a string field whose outer JSON escaping is owned by transport serialization.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The raw Responses request contains concatenated JSON; the captured OpenAI Chat provider request contains the identical invalid string; MiniMax rejects that exact call_id.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: Refuted if the selected OpenAI Chat provider receives raw malformed JSON, if the projected field parses to anything other than the original string, if paired tool output changes, or if ProviderReqCompat/Error05/provider switch is triggered.
hypotheses.verification_action: Replay paired and unpaired malformed items through a controlled Responses Relay path with one OpenAI Chat target; assert exactly one provider send, exact string equality in function.arguments, unchanged paired tool output, and no provider failure or reselect.

required_verification: controlled malformed-with-feedback OpenAI Chat transport capture count equals one and the paired tool output is unchanged
controlled malformed-without-feedback OpenAI Chat transport capture count equals one
both malformed cases preserve the exact original function.arguments string value
both malformed cases record no provider_request_compat_error and no V3TargetLocalReselected
valid OpenAI Chat field parity still sends exactly once
protocol conversion verifier and red fixtures pass
